description: Source code implementing a ring buffer for streaming data in Zephyr OS, including functions for writing to and reading from the stream with memory barriers and modular index calculations.

methods.name: idx_mod
methods.description: Calculates modular index within the ring buffer.

methods.name: idx_sub
methods.description: Computes modular subtraction for indices in the ring buffer.

methods.name: sys_winstream_write
methods.description: Writes data into the winstream buffer, handling overflow and wrapping.

methods.name: sys_winstream_read
methods.description: Reads data from the winstream buffer, handling underflow and wrapping.
